name: MF
purpose: Durable user-controlled registry of World Server projects that must not be abandoned between chats.

projects.title: Gothic Destruction MVP
projects.reason: Preserve and finish the user-approved cannon destruction system where voxel stones physically scatter as independent bodies.
projects.currentNextAction: Preserve the accepted fragmentation baseline, complete World Server production certification without regressing per-voxel scattering or graphics-first HUD, then request explicit owner closure.
doNotRegress: Never replace visible voxel fragmentation with one glued cluster rigid body.
Do not reduce physics semantics merely to recover FPS; optimize rendering/budgets first.
Keep persistent player HUD minimal and graphics-first.
Do not hand out a stored URL without fresh live verification.

projects.title: Trinity Lab
projects.reason: Preserve the user-approved unified Trinity baseline and finish continuous multi-location generation, gameplay weapons, and tri-style weapon rendering without regressing one canonical world state.
projects.currentNextAction: Implement the next bounded Trinity vertical slice: continuous forward location streaming with at least three substantially different generated locations, FIRE and SWITCH controls, at least three semantic WeaponSpecs rendered in KRIEGER/INK/CUBE, and selective deep-black INK contrast accents while preserving one canonical scene/world state.
doNotRegress: Do not split KRIEGER, INK and CUBE into independent scene/world data.
Preserve the user-approved KRIEGER graphics baseline.
Preserve Living Watercolor 3D as the INK foundation; do not regress to debug wireframe/toon rendering.
Preserve finished voxel-art intent for CUBE; do not regress to debug cubes.
Do not call a new implementation SUCCESS or FAILURE without an explicit user verdict.
Do not hand out a stored URL without fresh live verification.
